title: Initial Authorization of Covered Rental Days (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Clause.** The initial authorization on a Rental Vehicle Coordination reservation sets how many rental days someone other than the customer pays.

1. For a rental under the customer's own rental coverage (first-party rental coverage) and for a rental under another driver's insurer (third-party liability), it is the insurer's authorization of the planned repair days of the insurance claim repair order (the estimated repair days on that repair order), paid by the insurer; it is recorded only after the insurer has authorized the repair itself. The repair order the rental is for has been authorized by the insurer.
2. For a warranty courtesy rental it is the courtesy rental days of the warranty plan, paid by the network.
3. A customer-pay rental has no authorization.
4. First-party coverage pays at most the insurer's daily cap per day and the insurer's total rental limit for the claim in total, the part of the partner rate above the cap being the customer's where the class bills the daily-cap excess to the customer; third-party liability pays the partner rate of the class reserved.
5. The covered portion is billed directly where the class has direct billing to the insurer available.

## Coverage sources at a glance

| Who covers the rental | Initial authorization | Paid by | Daily limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Customer's own rental coverage | Planned repair days of the claim repair order | Insurer | The insurer's daily cap; the total rental limit for the claim also applies |
| Another driver's insurer | Planned repair days of the claim repair order | Insurer | The partner rate of the class reserved |
| Warranty courtesy | Courtesy rental days of the warranty plan | Network | Not set by this clause |
| Customer pay | None | Not applicable | Not applicable |

## The repair must be authorized first

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Applies to | Recording a covered-day authorization |
| Condition | The repair order the rental is for has been authorized by the insurer |
| Evidence | The status of that insurance claim repair order |
| Authority | The system record, read before the authorization is recorded |
| Statuses that meet it | Authorized, in repair, on hold, repair complete |

A repair order in any status outside those four has not met this condition.

## Hypothetical case

A Full-Size Rental under the customer's own rental coverage carries an insurer daily cap of 45.00 USD; the class partner rate is 52.99 USD. The insurer pays at most 45.00 USD for each covered day, and the remaining 7.99 USD of each covered day is the customer's, the class billing the daily-cap excess to the customer.
